description: This file contains utility functions for environment configuration in a React frontend project, including environment variable access, URL normalization, feature flag parsing, and WebSocket URL resolution. It exports functions for retrieving environment settings, constructing URLs, and feature flag management.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Safely retrieves an environment variable with an optional fallback.

methods.name: normalizeBaseUrl
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from a URL.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Combines base URL and path into a full URL, handling slashes.

methods.name: parseFeatureFlags
methods.description: Parses a string into an object of feature flags with boolean values.

methods.name: resolveWsUrl
methods.description: Determines the WebSocket URL based on environment variables and defaults.
